promptRecord: Descriptive production prompt specifications, not an exact raw tool/API log.

parts.promptSpecification: Regenerate authored 16-bit black symbiote/crimson Dracodia components from the original parts reference. Twelve separated alpha cells: headless torso; independent left/right arms; complete crown/head neutral, left, right, up, down, shocked, rupture, split-maw scream and speech. Wide transparent gutters, consistent identity and scale, no clipped tendrils or background grid.

portrait.promptSpecification: Reuse archived nine complete chrome/green/red Dracodia portrait expressions: idle, speech, confidence, anger, split-maw alien scream, shock, burning and decoding. Preserve bezel edges and native pixels; speaking changes only the mouth.

effects.promptSpecification: Sixteen separated true-alpha 16-bit alien reactor destruction effects: eight escalating golden/white explosions with crimson fire, black symbiote chips and crackle; four upward sun-rupture beams; four hollow smoke/fire rings. Match the dark symbiote boss, with wide gutters and complete effects inside each cell.

portal.promptSpecification: Twelve separated alpha oval blue/white energy portal frames with chrome ribs, empty transparent center and no drawn sheet lines. Four opening, four steady and four inward closing frames; crisp 16-bit sci-fi pixel detail, wide transparent gutters, no neighboring-cell overlap.

charred.promptSpecification: Six-cell true-alpha 16-bit charred-remains sheet for the black/crimson alien symbiote: hot wreckage, cooling remains, cold remains, claw wreckage, tentacle wreckage and ruptured chest. Physical opaque blackened fragments with crimson embers and light smoke; isolated complete cells with generous transparent gaps.

unselectedCandidates.reason: Portal cells too tightly packed for consistent complete frame extraction.

pixelPolicy: Measured crops and transparent padding only. Native pixels/alpha unchanged.
